statement: Archived-resource locator URLs can change, and rediscovered captures can differ in timestamp/status/original-URI or disappear.
actakit_implication: Capture identity cannot be the replay URL; preserve observed archive identity, datetime and source metadata separately.

statement: Following archived links can silently shift the effective historical datetime by large amounts.
actakit_implication: A query/output assembling archived evidence must not imply temporal coherence merely because pages are linked.
